settings.title: Your Business Growth, Backed by Blacklyte
settings.description: Blacklyte is a dynamic, fast-growing brand that partners with international esports events, professional players, and leading cross-industry brands to deliver immersive gaming experiences and ergonomic solutions. With a focus on high performance at competitive prices, Blacklyte appeals to a broad global audience. Our localized warehouses in the US, Canada, Europe, and Australia ensure fast, reliable delivery to key markets. We also support our dealers by managing end-customer aftersales, providing a consistent, professional, and customer-first global service experience — so you can focus on growing your business while we handle the rest.

settings.heading: 1. What is the minimum order quantity?
settings.content: We offer MOQ from 5 pieces to accommodate businesses of all sizes.

settings.heading: 2. Do you provide marketing materials?
settings.content: Yes. Dealers receive event media, product images, videos, and co-branding assets for local promotions.

settings.heading: 3. What are the shipping and lead times?
settings.content: Standard delivery is 2–5 days after the order is placed.

settings.heading: 4. What warranty and after-sales support is offered?
settings.content: All products come with standard warranties and full after-sales support to ensure a smooth experience for your customers.

settings.heading: 5. Can I customize Blacklyte products with my own logo?
settings.content: Absolutely. For orders of 50 units or more, we offer custom logo branding to help you strengthen your brand presence in the market. A small customization fee may apply, depending on your design needs.
